clips.title: The story
paras: "Sea Wolf" MacKinley in Booty Bay needs to balance his books by collecting outstanding debts from three old associates. Though rumors claim the men were cursed and bewitched into wandering ancient jungle ruins, MacKinley expects their prized possessions retrieved regardless of their grim fate.

Following your earlier collection efforts for "Sea Wolf" MacKinley, the pirate still holds an active ledger of unsettled debts. Three particular debtors—Maury "Club Foot" Wilkins, Jon-Jon the Crow, and Chucky "Ten Thumbs"—have let their accounts sit delinquent for months. MacKinley initially assumed the trio merely skipped out of Booty Bay to avoid paying, but he later heard they met a stranger and darker fate deep in the jungle.

Whispers say the three debtors were bewitched and cursed, leaving them to wander the ancient stonework northeast of Booty Bay at the Ruins of Aboraz and the Ruins of Jubuwal. Unconcerned with their misfortune, MacKinley directs you to venture into the ruins, track down each man, and seize their notable valuables: Jon-Jon's Golden Spyglass, Chucky's Huge Ring, and Maury's Clubbed Foot.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My list is shortening, but there are still people who owe me.
Next, we have Maury "Club Foot" Wilkins, Jon-Jon the Crow, and Chucky "Ten Thumbs."

These scurvy dogs' debts are months outstanding and I thought they skipped town to avoid paying up! Later, I heard they're cursed and bewitched and now wander the jungle ruins. But I don't care what their fate is - I want what's mine!
They're at the Ruins of Aboraz and the Ruins of Jubuwal, northeast of here. Find them, and collect.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, did you find those three dogs? Did you collect their valuables?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great! I can get a good price for these, especially for what's inside Maury's foot! Thanks much, friend!
I hope those three learned their lesson: don't bet something you can't afford to lose.
And maybe it's too late for them, but...they should be careful of who they gamble with.
